events.text: The army's fifth formation was formed from 31st Rifle Corps in Murmansk.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Its fifth formation was ( re ) formed from 31st Rifle Corps on 2 April 1952 in Murmansk

events.text: The army was disbanded at Murmansk.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The army was disbanded at Murmansk in early 1960

events.text: The army was reformed again from Headquarters Northern Military District with headquarters at Petrozavodsk.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The army was reformed again from Headquarters Northern Military District in May–June 1960 with headquarters at Petrozavodsk

events.text: The army was awarded the Order of the Red Banner.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 15 January 1970 , it was awarded the Order of the Red Banner

events.text: The 54th Motor Rifle Division was established in Alakurtti from the 54th Rifle Division.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 54th Motor Rifle Division ( Alakurtti ) Established on 4 June 1957 in Alakurtti from the 54th Rifle Division

events.text: The 338th Guards Tank Regiment was reduced and renamed 82nd independent Tank Battalion.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1987 the 338th Guards Tank Regiment was reduced and renamed 82nd independent Tank Battalion

events.text: The tank regiment was reduced to a battalion.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1987 the tank regiment was reduced to a battalion

events.text: The 88th Independent Helicopter Squadron was disbanded.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: 88th Independent Helicopter Squadron ( Apatity , Murmansk Oblast , from 1977 ) Disbanded 1991 or 1994

events.text: The 6th Rocket Brigade had been equipped with the Scud up until 1991.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: Up until 1991 it had been equipped with the Scud

events.text: The 6th Rocket Brigade was reequipped with the Tochka.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: From 1991 it was reequipped with the Tochka

events.text: The 16th Motor Rifle Division became the 5186th Base for Storage of Weapons and Equipment.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.object: 5186th Base for Storage of Weapons and Equipment
events.quote: In 1989 the 16th Motor Rifle Division ( mobilisation ) became the 5186th Base for Storage of Weapons and Equipment

events.text: The 37th became a weapons and equipment storage base (VKhVT).
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: the 37th similarly became a weapons and equipment storage base ( VKhVT )

events.text: The 111th Motor Rifle Division became the 20th Independent Motor Rifle Brigade and shifted into the 30th Guards Army Corps.
events.subject: part_of_self
events.quote: In 1994-95 the 111th Motor Rifle Division ( Sortavala ) became the 20th Independent Motor Rifle Brigade and shifted into the 30th Guards Army Corps

events.text: The army finally disbanded after the fall of the Soviet Union.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It finally disbanded after the fall of the Soviet Union in 1997-98
